descriptions.d24i_setting_format_80103c44: Look up the setting named by item +56 as a retained value handle (0x800fc1b0), making and dropping a copy of the name if absent; format the value by its kind (virtual +24: 2 float, 0 and 1 integer, 4 text) into a string, rename item +56 with it (0x801790bc) and re-sync through 0x80103a5c; an unknown kind drops a copy of the name, calls the value's virtual +28 and writes the error text 0x803994ec to the setting named by item +48; finally releases the handle.
